A1.fullText: People around the world drink coffee every day. Many people start their morning with a warm cup. Coffee shops are great places to meet friends and talk. Drinking coffee is a daily habit for millions.
sentences: People around the world drink coffee every day.
Many people start their morning with a warm cup.
Coffee shops are great places to meet friends and talk.
Drinking coffee is a daily habit for millions.

gistQuestion.question: What is the main topic of this text?
options: The daily habit of drinking coffee
The best dessert in coffee shops

A2.fullText: Coffee is more than just a drink; it is a global culture. In Italy, people enjoy a quick espresso at the counter before work. In Scandinavia, people pause their busy routine for a coffee break with pastries. Today, cafes are modern spaces where people study and work.
sentences: Coffee is more than just a drink; it is a global culture.
In Italy, people enjoy a quick espresso at the counter before work.
In Scandinavia, people pause their busy routine for a coffee break with pastries.
Today, cafes are modern spaces where people study and work.

gistQuestion.question: What does the text show about coffee?
options: Different countries have unique coffee traditions
Coffee is only popular in Italy

B1.fullText: The global coffee culture continues to transform how communities interact. While traditional coffee rituals emphasize mindfulness, modern specialty cafes focus on sustainable beans and precise brewing techniques. For millions of remote professionals, cafes have practically replaced traditional office spaces, becoming vibrant hubs of productivity and conversation.
sentences: The global coffee culture continues to transform how communities interact.
While traditional coffee rituals emphasize mindfulness, modern specialty cafes focus on sustainable beans and precise brewing techniques.

gistQuestion.question: According to the passage, how have modern cafes evolved?
options: They now only serve traditional tea

B2.fullText: The contemporary resurgence of coffee culture transcends simple caffeine consumption, evolving into a sophisticated sensory experience. Artisanal roasters prioritize fair-trade sourcing and intricate brewing parameters, highlighting regional flavor notes. Concurrently, the third-wave coffee movement has redefined urban socialization, transforming ordinary neighborhood venues into intellectual sanctuaries for creators and digital nomads.
sentences: The contemporary resurgence of coffee culture transcends simple caffeine consumption, evolving into a sophisticated sensory experience.

gistQuestion.question: What is the primary focus of the third-wave coffee movement mentioned?
options: Fast delivery of commercial powdered coffee

C1.fullText: Coffee’s sociological trajectory reflects broader anthropological shifts toward curated consumerism and ritualized leisure. Far beyond a biochemical stimulant, coffee acts as an omnipresent catalyst for deliberate contemplation and civic engagement. In an era dominated by hyper-accelerated digital connectivity, the artisanal coffee ritual offers an authentic somatic experience anchored in communal presence.
sentences: Coffee’s sociological trajectory reflects broader anthropological shifts toward curated consumerism and ritualized leisure.

gistQuestion.question: How does the author characterize coffee in modern society?
options: As an obsolete beverage with decreasing relevance

As a purely chemical product devoid of cultural meaning

C2.fullText: The pervasive hegemony of coffee across disparate civilizations exemplifies how an indigenous Ethiopian botanical commodity was systematically transmuted into the quintessential sacrament of industrial modernity. By sublimating solitary contemplation into shared metropolitan discourse, the contemporary cafe remains a bastion of democratic exchange, interrogating our relentless pursuit of productivity through the lens of convivial pause.
